topic: How can satellite link budgets be optimized for high throughput and low latency in global aeronautical coverage?
consensus_response: Satellite link budgets can be optimized by integrating adaptive modulation, beamforming, and precoding techniques. Hybrid beamforming mitigates interference, while precoding enhances SNR. Dynamic resource allocation and innovative constellation designs also contribute to high throughput and low latency.
reference_context: QoS provisioning in satellite networks requires managing capacity and latency, with techniques like QoS-OSPF and RSVP addressing bandwidth and admission control.
